translation.text: MDN train #2147 scheduled to arrive Fox Lake at 8:15 PM, may be operating 15 to 20 minutes behind schedule due to earlier freight train interference. Visit metratracker.com for the location of your train.
NCS train #115 scheduled to arrive Antioch at 7:15 PM, may be operating 15 to 20 minutes behind schedule due to speed restrictions. Visit metratracker.com for the location of your train.

The Washington St./Grayslake station is not ADA accessible due to station construction. Customers can use Prairie Crossing or Round Lake Beach as alternate boarding stations during this time. Metra will provide updates when ADA accessibility is restored.
UPN Kenosha Elevator Out of Service
The Kenosha elevator is out of service. Customers can use Zion or Winthrop Harbor as alternate boarding stations.
ME The Van Buren Street Platform elevator is back in service
The Van Buren Street Platform elevator is back in service
Due to construction, the east end of platform 2 (south platform) at Kedzie will be closed until the end of October. Please use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.
ME Beginning May 18 South Water Elevator Will Be Closed

Starting May 18, the South Water elevator will be closed during reconstruction. ADA passengers should use Van Buren St or Museum Campus/11th St for elevator access. For the latest service alert info visit Metra.com/MEelevators.
NCS train #117, scheduled to depart Chicago Union Station at 6:00 PM, is on the move and maybe operating with extensive delays due to earlier freight train interference.

The north/south parking lots at the 115th St/Morgan Park station are now open to the public and ADA accessibility has been restored. Station construction is expected to continue through Spring 2027. Metra will provide updates once construction is complete.

UPW train #62 scheduled to arrive Ogilvie Transportation Center at 7:15 PM, is on the move and operating 20 to 25 minutes behind schedule due to speed restrictions. Visit metratracker.com for the location of your train.
Sunday, July 19, No Train Service On UP-Northwest Line - Scheduled Track Repairs
On Sunday, July 19, there will be no train service on the UP-Northwest line due to scheduled track repairs. Make your alternate travel plans at Metra.com, Transitchicago.com, or Pacebus.com.
Union Pacific North Line Ravinia Park Station Notice

Beginning July 11, Metra trains will stop at the Ravinia Park Station starting at 5 p.m. Weekend service to Ravinia Park will begin mid-morning and continue throughout the day when events are scheduled.
